## About
Victor's Radiator Service is a radiator shop on W Holt Ave in Pomona. Radiator repair and maintenance is what we specialize in, because a bad radiator can lower your fuel mileage and shorten the life of your engine.
When you call, there's a good chance Victor picks up the phone himself. One reviewer said he explained exactly how to fix their radiator part and gave them more than one way to do it. Another wrote that integrity and honesty still exist at Victor's. We're rated 4.8 from 52 Google reviews.
Give us a call or send a message through the contact form to schedule an appointment.

## Services
- Radiator repair: Leaks, damage and cooling trouble fixed so your engine stays healthy.
- Radiator cleaning: One reviewer had their radiator repaired and cleaned before upgrading their cooling system.
- Radiator parts: Have a question about a radiator part? Give Victor a call.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call us, email us, or fill out the contact form with a detailed message and we'll get back to you.

Q: Can my car be done the same day?
A: We can have your vehicle serviced the same day.

Q: What if I'm not happy with the work?
A: We promise your satisfaction. If you're not satisfied, we'll reevaluate your vehicle.
